title: Skills
description: Company skills: add from a GitHub repo, enable for agents and sync to machines.
emptyHint: Add skills from a GitHub repo for agents to use.

add.title: Add skills from a GitHub repo
add.description: Scan a repo and choose the skills to add. A skill named like a pinned Superpowers skill cannot be added.
add.unknownSuperpowers: The Superpowers skill list of the machines is unknown
add.clash: Same name as Superpowers skill {{name}}, cannot be added
add.waitingAppHint: No machine has the app that takes jobs, so the skill is not synced yet. Open the skill page and press Sync once the app runs.
add.queueFailed: The skill was added but the sync job could not be queued

sync.loadFailed: Could not load the sync status
sync.waitingApp: Waiting for the 2P Crew app on {{host}}
sync.cancelled: The sync job for {{host}} was cancelled
sync.syncFailed: Could not queue the sync job

detail.agentsHint: Turn this skill on or off per agent. The change applies from the agent's next run.
detail.toggleFailed: Could not change the agent's skills
detail.readOnlyHint: This skill's content cannot be edited on the web.

leftover.title: Copies of deleted skills
leftover.hint: These skills were deleted but machines still hold a copy in ~/.crew/skills. The 2P Crew app removes the copy when it picks up the removal job.
leftover.waitingApp: {{name}}: waiting for the 2P Crew app on {{host}} to remove it

pinned.title: Pinned skills (Superpowers)
pinned.hint: Skills of the Superpowers build pinned on the machines, loaded by agents via --plugin-dir. They cannot be edited or deleted from the web.
pinned.hintVersion: Skills of Superpowers {{version}} pinned on the machines, loaded by agents via --plugin-dir. They cannot be edited or deleted from the web.
pinned.unknown: No machine has reported its pinned skills yet

info.title: Edit details of {{name}}
info.description: The skill name is not changed here; rename it with the name: line in SKILL.md (editable skills).
info.saveFailed: Could not save the skill details

editor.title: Edit content
editor.notText: This file cannot be edited on the web
editor.clash: The name {{name}} clashes with a pinned Superpowers skill, cannot save
editor.queueFailed: Could not queue the sync yet: {{error}}
editor.deleteBody: The file is removed from the skill. Agents get the new version from their next run.

fork.title: Create an editable copy
fork.description: Copy this skill into an editable Paperclip skill. Agents using this skill move to the new copy.
fork.name: New copy name
fork.clash: Clashes with Superpowers skill {{name}}, cannot create
fork.precheckFailed: Could not check the skill before copying
fork.reassign: Move {{count}} agents using it to the new copy
fork.failed: Could not create the editable copy
fork.heading: Create an editable copy
fork.hint: To edit a read-only skill, copy it into an editable one. The original stays; delete it later if unused.
fork.openOriginal: Open the original {{name}} to delete it if no longer used

upstream.title: Source and copies

hold.local_modifications: The skill was modified in place, the update will be held
hold.audit_hard_stop: The new version failed the safety audit

upstream.changeHint: The repo or branch of a skill cannot be changed in place. Add the skill from the new source, enable it for agents, then delete this skill.

delete.title: Delete skill {{name}}
delete.body: The skill is removed from every agent, deselected at its GitHub source (if any) and then deleted. Copies on machines are removed by the 2P Crew app.
delete.noAgents: No agent has this skill enabled.
delete.noMachines: No machine holds a copy yet.
delete.waitingApp: Waiting for the 2P Crew app on {{hosts}} to remove the copy
